item.title: Yin & Yang ≠ Good vs Evil
item.description: The biggest mistranslation in the history of wellness culture: Yin and Yang are NOT good and evil. In this first episode, Ollie walks you through the seesaw, the three rules nobody told you, and why you should stop driving nails through your internal balance. Plus: what Huangdi Neijing actually says about dynamic equilibrium. Featuring real guqin music by High Mountains Flowing Water.
item.itunes:summary: Yin and Yang are not good and evil. Ollie explains the seesaw, the three rules, and why you should stop fighting your body and start listening to it. Featuring guqin music.
